# Be10x Disability Certificate Guide

This repository contains a static, accessible reference web UI and supporting documentation for understanding the disability-certificate and UDID process in India.

The project is maintained by **@mukkum13**. It is an individual project and does not represent a company, agency, government body, medical provider, or official certification authority.

The guide provides process information only. It does not diagnose, assess eligibility, approve applications, or replace official sources and qualified professionals.
